issues.detail: The Greek 'μη ολον το εθνος αποληται' means 'the whole nation not perish' (i.e., the entire nation/people), but the Vietnamese renders 'cả dân ngoại' which means 'all the Gentiles/foreigners' — introducing a meaning not in the Greek. The Greek 'εθνος' here refers to the nation/people (Israel), not 'dân ngoại' (Gentiles). This changes the referent and the claim.
